s.how: Toss 125g blackberries and 125g raspberries with a spoon of honey and torn mint. Whip 250g ricotta until smooth. Toast slices of brioche and cut into squares. Spread with ricotta and spoon the berries on top just before serving.

Blitz 250g pitted black olives with 2 tbsp capers, a garlic clove, the juice of half a lemon and a splash of olive oil until rough. Slice a baguette, brush with oil and toast until crisp. Spread the tapenade thickly on the toasts.

m.how: Score a 2kg pork shoulder, rub with salt and dry overnight. Roast at 160C for 4 hours, adding apple halves and 1kg potato chunks for the last hour. Blast at 240C until the crackling bubbles. Serve with steamed broccolini on a long platter.

w.note: the three pixies making a mess of the cake
w.how: Beat 250g butter with 250g sugar, add 4 eggs and fold in 250g self-raising flour. Bake in 2 tins at 175C for 25 minutes. Stack with strawberry jam and whipped cream, ice in pastel colours and decorate with edible flowers. Slightly lopsided is fine.

d.how: Fill glasses with crushed ice, thin cucumber ribbons and a few mint leaves. Add a good splash of lime cordial and top with cold soda water. Stir gently until it glows green, like the fire at the edge of the Moors.
